observations: Photo 0: Large yellow industrial diesel engine block with fuel filter, hoses, and accessories; watermark reads "DNL EQUIPMENT SALES AND PORT HARCOURT"; appears used with grime and wear; no clearly readable model plate in this view.
Photo 1: Top of engine with gray valve cover; center plate shows a "C9" marking with a logo; tools and rags visible on top; same watermark; engine appears assembled but used.

claims.evidence: photo 1 shows C9 marking on valve cover; photo 0 shows engine block
no import documents or origin marks visible in photos
no running test or test evidence shown in photos
engine sound and internal condition cannot be assessed from photos
no hour meter or odometer visible in photos
external appearance cannot confirm internal disassembly history

response.reason: The item is identifiable as a Caterpillar C9 diesel engine from the C9 marking on the valve cover in photo 1; even with all seller claims unproven, it can be priced at its worst case as a used non-running engine.
